note: Digging yields (Dave 2026-10-21, job 84). A spade dig gives what the ground at the hole is made of, as shovelfuls: [item, min, max], the number rolled through luck (more when lucky) and counted into the pack by weight like any pick (what does not fit lands on the ground). yield is by the surface material name from data/tables/soils.json; 'rock' is bare rock showing (a stone or two). under: a chance of a second kind from the layer below the topsoil (wet lowland soils lie on clay). fill is what filling a hole uses up, tried in this order; the fill operation (River start, Ground) calls ServerItems.take_fill(peer, units). A shovelful weighs 4 to 5 kg (weights.json), so a body carries about nine before it slows.
